newsitem.title: CANADA: TransCanada prices US$200 mln pfd issue.
newsitem.headline: TransCanada prices US$200 mln pfd issue.

text.p: TransCanada PipeLines Ltd said on Friday it priced its US$200 million offering of Canadian Originated Preferred Securities.
The securities represent US$25 principal amount of junior subordinated debentures and bear interest at 8.50 per cent.

TransCanada said the issue should close on or about November 6. The company said it expected to raise about US$193 million in net proceeds from the offering. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes including the repayment of short-term debt incurred to finance TransCanada's non-regulated businesses.
The underwriting syndicate will be managed by Merrill Lynch & Co, Smith Barney Inc, Dean Witter Reynolds Inc, PaineWebber Inc and Prudential Securities Inc.
